description: Shared data foundation and the SINGLE additive Dexie v2 migration that every later FEAT builds on. Add the new domain types (WeightRecord, Mood, optional FastingSessionRecord.mood/note), bump the Dexie schema ONCE to add the `weights` table (sessions index string unchanged because mood/note are unindexed), add per-table DB helpers, extend the store (resetAll clears weights; stopFast returns the new session id so FEAT-004 can attach mood/note), and keep the full suite green. Dependency root for FEAT-002..FEAT-006. No UI and no copy strings here beyond types/db/store wiring.
steps: Read FIRST: the absolute context.json and this file. context.json replaces re-exploration; do not re-derive what it states.

src/types/index.ts: add `export interface WeightRecord { id?: number; weightKg: number; recordedAt: number; note?: string }` (Dexie auto PK id; recordedAt epoch ms). Add `export type Mood = "energik" | "biasa" | "lemes" | "lapar"`. Add OPTIONAL fields to FastingSessionRecord: `mood?: Mood;` and `note?: string;` (older rows stay valid with these undefined). Do NOT touch IconKey in this FEAT (each later FEAT adds its own keys to avoid churn).

src/db/db.ts: add `weights!: Table<WeightRecord, number>;` to HeulaDB (import WeightRecord from @/types). Keep the existing `this.version(1).stores({ sessions: ... })` block UNCHANGED, then add ONE additive line below it: `this.version(2).stores({ sessions: "++id, startMs, createdAt, completed, planId", weights: "++id, recordedAt" });`. The sessions index string is identical to v1 (mood/note are not indexed). This is additive — Dexie keeps all existing sessions rows and just creates the weights table.

Create src/db/weights.ts mirroring src/db/sessions.ts EXACTLY in style (module JSDoc noting client-only + ESLint boundary, DEV const, devError helper, every call wrapped in try/catch returning safe values): `add(record: WeightRecord): Promise<number | null>`, `remove(id: number): Promise<boolean>`, `all(): Promise<WeightRecord[]>` ordered by recordedAt ASCENDING (oldest->newest, best for charting; use `db.weights.orderBy("recordedAt").toArray()`), `clear(): Promise<boolean>`.

src/db/sessions.ts: add `setMoodNote(id: number, patch: { mood?: Mood; note?: string }): Promise<boolean>` using `await db.sessions.update(id, patch)` inside the same try/catch pattern (import Mood from @/types). Returns whether the update succeeded.
src/store/types.ts: change the AppState action signature `stopFast(now?: number): Promise<void>` to `stopFast(now?: number): Promise<number | null>` (returns the new session id, or null on failure).

src/store/useAppStore.ts: in stopFast, capture `const id = await sessions.add(record);` then `set({ activeFast: null }); return id;` (so callers get the new row id). In resetAll, additionally clear weights: add `import * as weights from "@/db/weights";` and call `await weights.clear();` alongside `await sessions.clear();` before the state reset. Do not change the partialize whitelist or any other behavior.
acceptance_criteria: src/types/index.ts exports WeightRecord and Mood, and FastingSessionRecord has optional mood?: Mood and note?: string.
src/db/db.ts has a single additive version(2) bump adding the weights store; the v1 block and the sessions index string are unchanged.
src/db/weights.ts exists with add/remove/all/clear wrapped in try/catch returning safe values, all() ordered by recordedAt ascending.
src/db/sessions.ts exports setMoodNote; useAppStore stopFast returns Promise<number | null> and resetAll clears the weights table.
`npx tsc --noEmit` is clean and `npx vitest run` stays green at 185+ tests (no logic regression).
findings:
DONE. Verified: tsc clean, vitest 186 passed (baseline 185 + 1 new no-emoji scan test for src/db/weights.ts), lint 0 errors (2 PRE-EXISTING warnings in src/lib/notifications.ts:162 and src/lib/recommendation.ts:256, both untouched), next build OK. Four layout files byte-identical to HEAD (empty git diff). Committed on main as the only non-artifact change set.

EXPORTED SIGNATURES for later FEATs:

src/types/index.ts:
- interface WeightRecord { id?: number; weightKg: number; recordedAt: number; note?: string } (recordedAt = epoch ms; id is Dexie auto PK)
- type Mood = "energik" | "biasa" | "lemes" | "lapar"
- FastingSessionRecord now has optional `mood?: Mood` and `note?: string` (both undefined on older persisted rows — guard before use). IconKey UNCHANGED (each later FEAT adds its own keys).

src/db/db.ts:
- HeulaDB now has `weights!: Table<WeightRecord, number>`. Single additive this.version(2).stores({ sessions: "++id, startMs, createdAt, completed, planId" (IDENTICAL to v1), weights: "++id, recordedAt" }). v1 block unchanged. mood/note are NOT indexed.

src/db/weights.ts (NEW, mirrors sessions.ts try/catch pattern, module is client-only / ESLint boundary):
- add(record: WeightRecord): Promise<number | null>  (null on failure)
- remove(id: number): Promise<boolean>
- all(): Promise<WeightRecord[]>  (ordered by recordedAt ASCENDING, oldest->newest, best for charting; uses db.weights.orderBy("recordedAt").toArray())
- clear(): Promise<boolean>

src/db/sessions.ts (ADDED):
- setMoodNote(id: number, patch: { mood?: Mood; note?: string }): Promise<boolean>  (uses db.sessions.update(id, patch); returns whether update succeeded; FEAT-004 uses this to attach mood/note after stopFast)

src/store/types.ts + useAppStore.ts:
- stopFast(now?: number): Promise<number | null> — NOW RETURNS the new session id from sessions.add, or null on no-op (no activeFast) OR on sessions.add failure (both map to null; callers can't distinguish). State still sets activeFast:null and the function still clears activeFast as before.
- resetAll() now also calls `await weights.clear()` (after sessions.clear(), before state reset). partialize whitelist UNCHANGED (weights live in Dexie, not persisted store).

NO deviations from the FEAT-001 brief.
